|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Black 1]]; it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip, which prints it; the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text (see [[Black 1]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Black 1]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “May add Black Leader as pilot. TIEs are immune to Don't Get Cocky. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a Black Squadron TIE. Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 5.” The PC website card list (in every capture from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) showed the same text, with the ▲ written out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-56-Black_1.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-black1-pre.gif]]) print it.<ref name="cl-1261_56-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) names Juno Eclipse instead of Black Leader<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=52, page 52. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=52 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add Juno Eclipse as pilot. TIEs are immune to Don't Get Cocky. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a Black Squadron TIE. Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 5.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-56-front-master.png]]) prints it.
